oneLineSummary: 4-stage cascading filter recommended: (d) Coxeter relation enumeration tau^2=sigma^3=(tau*sigma)^2=e cheapest filter -> (c) structure-constant preservation (defining condition for sedenion automorphism, rules out S6) -> (a) Schreier-Sims BSGS (deterministic |G|=6 certificate) -> (b) character-theoretic audit.
rootCause: Single approach insufficient: Schreier-Sims gives |G| but not isomorphism class (Z6 vs S3 collision); characters distinguish iso-class but require known abstract group; structure-constant is necessary-sufficient for automorphism but silent on order; presentation pins iso-class but needs candidate generators. Combinatorial OR algebraic OR spectral OR presentation each probe different facet.
recommendation: Cascade order: (d)+(c)+(a)+(b). Critical insight: (d) alone is the over-permissive trap when applied to S_6 acting on 6 letters without sedenion-action stage (c). Minimum honest test = (d)+(c). (a)+(b) raise confidence.
references: Isaacs Character Theory of Finite Groups AMS
caveats: S3 ~= D_3 ~= Z6 set-collision: distinguishing requires non-abelian check (tau*sigma != sigma*tau). Sedenion basis convention (Cawagas vs Moreno vs Imaeda-Imaeda) differ in sign tables; wrong convention spuriously fails (c).
